subject: Agriculture
title: Managed Aquifer Recharge
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Managed Aquifer Recharge.

hook.text: What if we could refill aquifers on purpose—banking water underground when it's abundant?

buildup.text: Managed aquifer recharge spreads floodwater over permeable land, letting it seep down into the water table.

discovery.text: California's 'Flood-MAR' program diverts excess river flow onto farmland in winter to recharge aquifers.

twist.text: Not all soils or aquifers work for recharge. Clay blocks infiltration, and some aquifers trap contaminants.

climax.text: Ancient India used check dams and percolation tanks for recharge. The idea is old—the scale is new.

punchline.text: Saving water underground is the next frontier of irrigation.

quiz.question: What is managed aquifer recharge?
options: Deliberately spreading surface water over land to refill aquifers
